corrected_text: Agello's Vendor/README.md said at a691212 that Vendor/LiteRT-LM is a pruned copy of our fork PowerBeef/agello-litert-lm (one branch, main) at 6da75396; since Agello f51fe1d (2026-11-18) it says the copy is main's swift/ at 82b05ea1 with the binary of release agello-one-20261115, built from 6da75396, whose CLiteRTLM.xcframework.zip its Package.swift pins.
